posts.title: Wyoming council backs felony sweepstakes casino ban that reaches payment and hosting suppliers
posts.description: A bill now sponsored by Wyoming's Legislative Management Council would make running a dual-currency sweepstakes casino a felony. The draft also targets the vendors behind these sites, which raises the legal risk for payment processors and B2B suppliers. The post Wyoming council backs felony sweepstakes casino ban that reaches payment and hosting suppliers appeared first on ReadWrite .

posts.title: MGM Resorts and BetMGM quit National Council on Problem Gambling over Kalshi membership
posts.description: MGM Resorts and BetMGM have canceled their memberships in the National Council on Problem Gambling because the group accepted Kalshi. Their exit brings licensed operators into a split over prediction markets that had so far involved regulators and state problem-gambling councils. posts.title: CFTC loses second bid to shield Kalshi as New York judge weighs order with national reach
posts.description: Two federal judges have now declined to protect Kalshi from New York's state-court gambling enforcement. The case moves to a state judge, and Kalshi disputes how far the proposed order would reach beyond New York.
